decision: Narrow RQ-001 to RQ-001-N5: language must contain mechanism information conditional on the complete non-linguistic trajectory and strictly refine the trajectory-only causal equivalence class under permutation-aware evaluation. No audited public benchmark currently supplies aligned raw language, interactive trajectories, independently defined mechanism variation, justified target/abstraction ground truth and held-out mechanism splits together. Empirical Gate I is therefore unavailable; SILG remains Gate-L-only and researcher-authored intervention labels are prohibited.
next_action: Complete novelty audit for independently defined public mechanism-change datasets with aligned raw language; if none qualifies, close empirical Gate I and preregister a theory-only impossibility/sufficiency question.
